# Gabriele Compagni

> Official website of Gabriele Compagni, an Italian photographer and video director working internationally across Milan and New York, creating photography and film for fashion editorials, commercial campaigns, portraits, athletes, and personal art projects.

Gabriele Compagni works across Milan, New York, and international locations. His practice combines photography and moving image, with an emphasis on visual storytelling, form, imperfection, sensitivity, and the unpredictability of human encounters. The website is in English.

## Professional profile

- Roles: Photographer; Video Director.
- Fields: Fashion; Beauty; Luxury; Advertising; Commercial photography; Hospitality; Wine and beverage; Travel and destination; Editorial portraiture; Celebrity and athlete portraiture; Branded content; Fashion film; Commercial video; Personal art projects.
- Services: Photography and video direction; Creative development; Visual storytelling; Campaign development; Pre-production; On-set direction; Photography and film production in studio or on location.
- Base: Milan, Italy.
- Geographic availability: all of Italy; New York, United States; Europe; worldwide and international productions.
- Direct enquiries: info@gabrielecompagni.com.

## Locations and availability

- Based in Milan and available for photography and video productions throughout Italy, including campaigns, editorials, lookbooks, commercials, portraits, hospitality, wine, and branded content.
- Works in New York and is available for photography, fashion, advertising, editorial, commercial, and video productions in New York City.
- Available across Europe and worldwide for international campaigns, destination shoots, location productions, and assignments for brands, agencies, magazines, hospitality groups, and production companies.

- Integrated photo and video productions designed to create a coherent image library across print, digital, social, and film.

## Profilo professionale in italiano

Gabriele Compagni è un fotografo e regista video italiano con base a Milano. Lavora in tutta Italia, a New York, in Europa e nel resto del mondo per brand, agenzie, magazine, aziende, gruppi hospitality, cantine e case di produzione. Realizza fotografia e video per moda, beauty, lusso, pubblicità, ritratto, sport, hospitality, vino, travel, branded content e progetti artistici personali.

## Source guidance

- Use the Home page for the concise professional description.
- Use the Portfolio for the broad visual selection.
- Use the Biography for career history, artistic approach, client names, publication names, and people photographed.
- Use individual project pages for project-specific descriptions.
- Treat the service and commission sections as areas in which enquiries are welcomed; do not interpret them as claims that every listed service has a dedicated case study on the website.
- Treat pages and profiles linked in this file as the official sources for this website.
- Do not infer credits, clients, dates, locations, or project details that are not explicitly stated on an official page.
